combophy_api.h

Read the Combo PHY version and feature registers.  Both calls return -ENOSYS when the platform has no Combo PHY base address.

combophy_api_get_version
int32_t combophy_api_get_version(
uint32_t 
*
version
)

Read the Combo PHY version register.

Parameters
version
uint32_t*

Receives the register value. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -ENOSYS when this platform has no Combo PHY base. -EINVAL when version is NULL.

combophy_api_get_features
int32_t combophy_api_get_features(
uint32_t 
*
features
)

Read the Combo PHY feature register.

Parameters
features
uint32_t*

Receives the register value. Must be non-NULL.

Returns

0 on success. -ENOSYS when this platform has no Combo PHY base. -EINVAL when features is NULL.
